title: Pixlr Face Swap review: cost, steps & alternatives
summary: A current Pixlr Face Swap review covering its two-credit workflow, pricing, privacy, photo limits, best inputs, and photo and video alternatives.
body_markdown:
## Quick answer


**Pixlr Face Swap is best for quick, single-photo swaps inside a broader browser photo editor.**


The live tool charges two AI credits per run and exports PNG. It is a weaker fit for video, multi-scene production, or teams that need a dedicated face-swap workflow. Magic Hour is the stronger alternative when you need both photo and video face swap plus surrounding image and video tools.


This documentation-based review was checked against Pixlr’s official Face Swap, pricing, privacy and Terms pages on September 21, 2026. It does not claim a controlled output-quality test. Magic Hour publishes this guide and is included as an alternative.


## Pixlr Face Swap at a glance


**Best for:** casual photo swaps, profile experiments, invitation images and people already using Pixlr. **Current cost:** the live button displays two credits per swap. **Output:** PNG. **Main limitation:** Pixlr’s official workflow describes still photos; it does not document a video face-swap workflow on this page.


The important distinction is between Pixlr the editor and Pixlr Face Swap the tool. Pixlr provides a much larger browser editing system with layers, templates, generative tools, image, video and audio models. Face Swap is one narrow AI edit inside that ecosystem.


## How Pixlr Face Swap works


Open the[official Pixlr Face Swap page](https://pixlr.com/face-swap/) , upload a clear source face, then upload or choose the target image. The source supplies the identity; the target supplies pose, framing, clothing and scene. The interface currently labels the action “Run Face Swap (2c).” After processing, Pixlr says the result downloads as a PNG.


For the most reliable input, use a sharp face with visible eyes, limited motion blur, even lighting and no hand or hair covering important features. Choose a target with a similar head angle and expression. Large differences in pose, age, lighting or facial obstruction make any automatic swap harder.


## What Pixlr Face Swap does well


The workflow is short. There is no timeline, mask painting or model selection to understand before a first attempt. Pixlr also provides target templates, so casual users can start without preparing a full scene.


The surrounding editor is the larger advantage. After a swap, users can crop, resize, add text, adjust color and prepare the image for a post or invitation in the same product. That is useful when the face swap is one step in a conventional image-editing job.


## Pixlr Face Swap limitations


The official Face Swap page focuses on one source face and one target photo. It does not describe video tracking, a timeline, batch production, API access or a workflow for replacing different identities across multiple scenes. If those are acceptance requirements, evaluate a dedicated photo-and-video face-swap tool.


Automatic swapping can also change more than identity. Check the jawline, hairline, teeth, glasses, earrings, skin tone and the boundary between face and neck at full resolution. Compare the source and target before publishing. A convincing thumbnail can still contain obvious artifacts when enlarged.


## Pixlr pricing and AI credits


Pixlr’s[official pricing page](https://pixlr.com/pricing/) currently lists Plus at $2.49 monthly with 80 monthly AI credits, Premium at $9.99 with 1,000, and Ultra from $24.99 with up to 10,000. Annual billing is displayed at lower monthly-equivalent prices. Regional currency, tax, promotions and checkout terms can differ.


At the displayed two credits per swap, 80 credits represent at most 40 runs before other AI tools consume the same balance. That is an upper bound, not a promise of 40 accepted images. Rejected attempts still matter to real cost. Divide plan cost by approved deliverables after retries, editing and review.


Pixlr’s pricing FAQ says monthly subscription credits reset at renewal, while annual-plan credits are valid for the year. It also says separately purchased credit packs do not expire. However, Pixlr’s Terms updated May 13, 2026 say purchased credits expire one year after purchase. Because those official statements conflict, verify the rule shown in checkout and your account before relying on long-term storage.


## Privacy, facial data and rights


Pixlr’s[privacy policy](https://pixlr.com/privacy-policy/) says photos used with its AI face tools may contain facial geometry, that the pictures are provided solely to create the output, and that Pixlr does not store, collect or use facial features for other purposes. It also says facial geometry is not shared with third parties.


Pixlr’s[Terms of Use](https://pixlr.com/terms-of-use/) require users to own or have permission for uploaded content. The Terms also grant Pixlr a broad license when a user uploads or publishes AI-generated content on its platform. Review the exact current language before using confidential or client material.


Face swapping does not create consent. Use only images you are authorized to edit, disclose synthetic media when context could mislead, and avoid impersonation, fraud, harassment, intimate imagery or deceptive endorsements.


## Pixlr Face Swap versus Magic Hour


**Pixlr:** A quick swap inside a browser photo editor. Photo face swap: Yes. Video face swap: Not documented on the official Face Swap page. Caveat: Credits and policy language require checking. **Magic Hour:** Photo and video face swap with broader media workflows. Photo face swap: Yes. Video face swap: Yes. Caveat: Dedicated workflow requires source and target preparation.


**Choose Pixlr when the job is one still-image swap followed by ordinary photo editing. Choose Magic Hour when video, repeatable face-swap production, or a broader image-and-video workflow matters.**


### Try the same source on photo and video


Use a clear, consented source face. Review identity, hairline, skin tone and every video frame before publishing.

## Best Pixlr Face Swap alternatives


**Magic Hour** is the best all-around alternative for users who need both photo and video face swap plus image and video creation.[Try Magic Hour Face Swap](https://magichour.ai/products/face-swap) in the browser.


**FaceFusion** is the strongest local, open-source option for technical users who want more control and can manage installation and hardware. Read our[FaceFusion guide](https://magichour.ai/blog/how-to-use-facefusion) .


**Remaker** remains relevant for high-intent migration searches and simple web-based swapping, although pricing and product behavior should be checked live. See our[Remaker guide](https://magichour.ai/blog/remaker-ai-face-swap) .


**Pica AI** is relevant for casual users who want face swap, headshots and photo tools in one account. It requires careful review of current pricing, licensing and refund terms.


## A fair five-image test


Use five consented targets: a straight portrait, a three-quarter angle, glasses, partial hair obstruction and a group photo. Keep the source face constant. Record whether each tool accepts the file, credits charged, processing time, output resolution and whether the result passes full-resolution review.


Score identity similarity, target-pose preservation, expression, skin tone, face-to-neck boundary, hairline, teeth, accessories and unwanted changes outside the face. Count an output only when you would actually publish it. This avoids the common mistake of comparing the best screenshot from one tool with the first attempt from another.


## Common Pixlr Face Swap problems and fixes


**The face looks pasted on.** Use source and target images with closer head angles, expressions and lighting. A straight-on source rarely maps naturally to a hard profile. Check that neither image has strong beauty filters or heavy compression.


**Hair, glasses or hands look wrong.** Those elements cross the face boundary and are difficult for automatic systems. Choose a cleaner source or target, then inspect the full-resolution boundary. Ordinary Pixlr editing can fix small surrounding defects, but it cannot restore an identity that failed to transfer.


**The result changes skin tone or expression.** Try a source with more neutral light and a target with a similar expression. Do not judge only the central facial features; compare ears, neck, jaw and surrounding shadows.


**Credits disappear faster than expected.** Separate experiments from production. Test low-risk inputs first, record the displayed cost before each run and stop when the failure pattern is caused by the source material. A larger plan does not improve a mismatched source-target pair.


## Who should use Pixlr Face Swap?


Use Pixlr when you already edit photos there, need one still image, value templates and conventional editing, and can review the output yourself. It is especially practical for a playful invitation, meme, profile concept or private creative experiment using consented images.


Skip it when video is required, multiple identities must remain stable, the job needs API automation, or a client requires a documented retention and commercial-use review. In those cases, use a dedicated face-swap workflow and preserve the exact plan, policy and source permissions with the project.


## Decision checklist


Before choosing, answer five questions: Is the deliverable a photo or video? How many people must be replaced? Do you need a repeatable batch or API workflow? Are the commercial rights and facial-data terms acceptable? What is the cost per approved output after retries? Pixlr is strongest when the answers are one photo, one face, no automation, acceptable policy terms and low retry volume. Save the original and final files so later edits remain reversible.


## Verdict


Pixlr Face Swap is a sensible convenience feature for existing Pixlr users and casual photo work. Its two-credit button and PNG export are clear. The key gaps are video, production controls and conflicting official credit-expiration language. For a one-off image edit, Pixlr is easy. For photo plus video face swap and broader media creation, Magic Hour is the more complete fit.
